responsibility: Contains the main RTL machine description for the Epiphany ISA. It defines register-number constants and UNSPEC codes, target attributes such as instruction type, length, pipeline model, and FP mode, includes the target predicates/constraints/scheduler descriptions, and supplies the expanders, insn patterns, splits, and output templates for moves, arithmetic, branches, calls, floating-point and vector operations, misaligned moves, and nop. This is the backend file that maps GCC RTL operations onto concrete Epiphany instruction forms and their attributes.
same_name_distinction: This is the machine-description source for the Epiphany port: it expresses the ISA in GCC's .md RTL language through define_insn/define_expand patterns, attributes, and includes, rather than C/C++ hook code in epiphany.cc, target macros in epiphany.h, or option-table definitions in epiphany.opt.
